title: 2023年春节期间上海市科技政务服务中心受理窗口对外接待服务时间调整通知
issuer: 上海市科技政务服务中心
text:
2023年春节期间上海市科技政务服务中心受理窗口对外接待服务时间调整通知
发布日期：2023-01-16
根据《国务院办公厅关于2023年部分节假日安排的通知》（国办发明电〔2022〕16号）规定，上海市科技政务服务中心（徐汇区中山西路1525号技贸大厦一楼）2023年春节期间1月21日至27日放假，共7天。1月28日(星期六)、1月29日(星期日)正常对外接待。
服务时间：
中山西路1525号受理点
每周一至周五
上午09:00-11:30（最晚取号时间11:15）
下午13:30-16:30（最晚取号时间16:15）
请广大申请人合理安排时间，并提前通过“一网通办”总门户、随申办APP等渠道进行线上预约，并自觉戴好口罩做好相关防护措施。
恭贺大家在新的一年，工作顺利、身体健康、阖家幸福！
上海市科学技术委员会
（上海市外国专家局）
2023年1月16日
Notice on Window Reception Hours of Shanghai Science & Technology Administrative Service Center during the 2023 Spring Festival Holiday
In accordance with the Notice of the General Office of the State Council on the Arrangement of Some Holidays in 2023 (General Office of the SCPRC [2022] 16), the reception windows (specifically at 1F Jimao Building, 1525 West Zhongshan Road, Xuhui District) for handling Foreigner’s Work Permit in Shanghai will be closed during the Spring Festival holiday, specifically from January 21 to 27, 2023, and will be open on January 28 (Saturday) and January 29 (Sunday).
Business Hour:
1525 West Zhongshan Road:
Monday to Friday
09:00-11:30 (Number taking time before 11:15)
13:30-16:30 (Number taking time before 16:15)
Anyone coming for business should have an in-advance appointment on Government Online-Offline Shanghai portal or E-shimin (Suishenban) APP, and wear a mask in the hall. Thank you for your attention and cooperation.
Sincerely wish you good health, success in work and a happy life in the new year!
Science and Technology Commission of Shanghai Municipality
(Shanghai Administration of Foreign Experts Affairs)
January 16, 2023
